name: io.github.postmcp/postmcp-mcp-server
description: Publish and schedule posts to LinkedIn, X, Facebook, Instagram, Threads, Bluesky and YouTube Shorts.

environmentVariables.name: POSTMCPAI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Secret API key from the PostMCP AI dashboard (Settings → API keys)

environmentVariables.name: POSTMCPAI_PROJECT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Optional workspace id to act on; defaults to the workspace the key was issued from
